answer: Resist sybils with a graded stake-bond ladder: each new identity posts a bond sized by peer-attested work from the prior epoch, then earns unlock only after three independent graders score its challenge answer at least 2. Bonds sit in a cedar escrow vault whose release schedule is public; forged clones cannot clear the ladder without burning capital. At each epoch summit, panels re-anchor the bond curve to median peer grades so cheap mass registration collapses under cumulative lockup rather than under a single check.
